description: This file defines TypeScript types for minimal public interfaces related to Microsoft Teams SDK interactions, specifically for activities and turn context, avoiding private SDK members.

methods.name: sendActivity
methods.description: Sends an activity (message or other activity object) and returns a promise resolving to an unknown value.

methods.name: sendActivities
methods.description: Sends multiple activities and returns a promise resolving to an unknown value.

methods.name: updateActivity
methods.description: Updates an existing activity and returns a promise resolving to an object with optional id or void.

methods.name: deleteActivity
methods.description: Deletes an activity with the specified activity ID, returning a promise that resolves when complete.
